_about: Methyl myristate (1) + Methyl palmitate (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 0.5 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of methyl myristate, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: R. Chen, H. Ding, M. Liu, J. Qi, H. Zhou, N. Chen, Isobaric vapor liquid equilibrium for binary system of methyl myristate + methyl palmitate at 0.5, 1.0 and 1.4 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 382 (2014) 133-138
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.68 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
